crewCard.madeSub: Welcome to the crew. Don't get busted.

chapters.job: The crew gets made. First contact with the Handler.
chapters.endsOn: The Handler reveals there’s a job worth eight figures.
chapters.transmission:
Listen up. I’m only saying this once.
You weren’t supposed to make it this far. Most people get made at the door. You didn’t. That means somebody upstairs thinks you’ve got something.
Name’s the Handler. I run this crew — and as of tonight, that’s you. There’s a job coming, the kind people spend their whole lives waiting for. Eight figures. One window.
But first you prove you can hang. You follow my lead, you make it out. Maybe.
Welcome to Grand Theft After-Dark. Don’t get wasted. Don’t get busted. And the only voice you trust in this room — is mine.
Now — decks are hot. Let’s play.

chapters.job: Prove you belong. The crew is tested on a small score.

chapters.transmission:
Crew — it’s me. The Handler. Night 02.
Here’s where we are: prove you belong. Tonight the crew gets tested on a small score.
You know the drill. Keep the energy up, keep the room moving, keep the crew loyal — that’s how we stay clean. That’s the job.
We’re too close now. Stay with me.
That’s the story. Now — decks are hot. Let’s play.

chapters.transmission:
This is it. No more rehearsals. No more talking.
Everything — every night, every favor, every body — it all led here. The vault’s open. The crew’s in position. The clock is running.
You know your jobs. You know the risks. There’s no walking out of this room the same way you walked in.
Tonight we take the whole thing. Tonight we become legends or we go down trying.
Decks are hot. Crew — let’s go to work.

chapters.job: The Handler drops the act. The real plan — a long con — comes to light.
chapters.endsOn: Every job, every night — it was all one long con.
chapters.transmission:
You want the truth? Fine. You’ve earned it.
I’ve been running crews for twenty-five years. Different cities. Different faces. Different scores. You think this started with you? It started before some of you were born.
Every operative I ever ran thought they were pulling the job. They were the job. And so were you.
But here’s the thing — I didn’t lie about one thing. This crew? You’re the best I’ve ever had.
So before this all comes apart — decks are hot. Let me give you a night you’ll never forget.

chapters.job: The finale. The crew becomes myth. A celebration of everything.
chapters.endsOn: The story closes. But legends never really end…
chapters.transmission:
Twenty-four nights. One crew. One impossible run.
They said it couldn’t be done. They said you’d turn on each other, get caught, get buried. Look around. You’re still standing.
What we built here doesn’t end when the lights come up. It becomes a story. The kind people tell for years. The kind that turns into legend.
You are the syndicate now. Every one of you.
Decks are hot — one last time. Let’s make it the loudest night this city has ever seen.

missions.name: THE LINEUP
missions.props: Height marker backdrop, single spotlight, phone with vertical camera ready
missions.howItRuns: Pull 3–5 people on stage. Line them up like a mugshot. Read each person’s mock “rap sheet” on mic (“Suspect #1: charged with looking too good tonight”). Take the photo. Crowd cheers loudest for the Most Wanted.
missions.win: Loudest crowd reaction = Most Wanted. Winner gets a drink ticket.
missions.handlerVO: Line ‘em up. Eyes forward. Don’t smile — you’re looking at a long sentence.
missions.variation: MOST-WANTED RANKINGS — instead of one winner, the crowd ranks all 5 from “Most Wanted” to “Rookie.” Each rank gets a different mock charge.

missions.name: THE GETAWAY — BALLOON CHASE
missions.props: 20–30 red balloons (“getaway cars”), 20–30 blue balloons (“police”), tape boundaries on the floor
missions.howItRuns: Pull 5–6 people. Each gets ONE red balloon. The crowd gets the blue balloons. The crew has to keep their red balloon in the air for 60 seconds while the crowd bats blue balloons to knock theirs down. Last red balloon standing wins.
missions.win: Last crew member with their red balloon still in the air at the 60-second buzzer.
missions.handlerVO: Five stars. Choppers up. Keep your car in the air or you’re done.
missions.variation: ESCALATION MODE — every 20 seconds you call up the wanted level and add more blue balloons. By 60s the room is chaos.

missions.name: THE SHOOTOUT — NERF GALLERY
missions.props: 2–3 Nerf guns (dart blasters), 5–6 cardboard target cutouts (silhouettes painted black & pink), a folding table
missions.howItRuns: Pull 3 contestants. Each gets 10 darts. 30 seconds to knock down as many targets as possible. Crowd counts down. Highest score wins.
missions.win: Most targets knocked down in 30 seconds.
missions.handlerVO: This is what we trained you for. Don’t miss.
missions.variation: MOVING TARGETS — a staffer walks behind the table holding targets above their head (safely above shoulders), making them moving. Bigger laughs, more skill required.

missions.name: THE DEAD DROP — BRIEFCASE HOT POTATO
missions.props: 1 black briefcase ($15 on Amazon), filler weight inside, silly reward (candy, fake cash, stickers)
missions.howItRuns: Earlier in the night, hand the briefcase to someone in the crowd: “Keep it moving. Don’t open it. If you’re holding it when the music stops, you’re holding the evidence.” The briefcase circulates while you DJ. At mission time, cut the music abruptly. Whoever’s holding it comes to stage. They open it OR pick a silly punishment.
missions.win: Be holding it when the music stops. Or don’t. Either way the bit pays off.
missions.time: 2 min on stage (background play happens during 30+ min of the set)
missions.handlerVO: Drop’s active. Don’t look at the briefcase. Don’t talk about the briefcase. Move it.
missions.variation: TIMED DROPS — cut the music 2–3 times across the night instead of once. Each “drop” gets a smaller bit; the final drop is the big stage moment.

missions.name: THE INFORMANT HUNT — FIND THE RAT
missions.props: 5 colored wristbands handed out at the door (4 the same color, 1 different)
missions.howItRuns: At doors, secretly hand 5 people wristbands — four matching, one odd. At mission time: “Crew check. If you got a wristband, to the stage.” On stage, the crowd has to spot which one is the rat (the odd-colored band). Once identified, the rat does a punishment moment. The four crew get small rewards.
missions.win: Crowd correctly identifies the rat by band color.
missions.handlerVO: Somebody in this crew’s wearing a wire. Find them before the score goes down.
missions.variation: DOUBLE RAT — hand out 6 wristbands (4 matching, 2 odd). Crowd has to find BOTH rats. Higher difficulty, bigger payoff.

missions.name: THE BAGMAN — BEACH BALL VAULT FILL
missions.gtaRef: Looting the vault / stuffing the duffel
missions.props: 4–5 beach balls (spray-painted gold = “money bags”), 2 large bins / laundry baskets / boxes
missions.howItRuns: Two teams of 3 pulled from the crowd. Beach balls are tossed into the crowd at the start. Teams have to retrieve as many “money bags” from the crowd and get them into THEIR team’s bin within 60 seconds. The crowd is the obstacle — they can throw them, hide them, bat them away.
missions.win: Most balls in your team’s bin at the 60-second buzzer.
missions.handlerVO: Vault’s open. Grab everything you can. Don’t leave a dollar.
missions.variation: GUARD MODE — one player from each team is designated “guard” — they stand at their bin and can deflect incoming balls from the other team. Adds defense to offense.

missions.name: THE HACK — LASER GRID
missions.props: 2 A-frame stands or chair posts, 3–4 rolls of red crepe streamer OR red string + masking tape, blacklight optional
missions.howItRuns: Set up a “laser grid” between two stands at the front of the stage — a web of crisscrossed red lines across a 6-foot doorway. Pull 2–3 contestants. They have to crawl, duck, or limbo through without touching a single line. Crowd counts touches.
missions.win: Fewest lines touched. Fastest time as tiebreaker.
missions.handlerVO: One wrong move and the whole place lights up. Take your time. Don’t. Touch. Anything.
missions.variation: BLINDFOLD HACK — same grid, but contestant is blindfolded and their partner from the crowd has to talk them through it using only voice. Doubled comedy.

missions.name: THE BLUEPRINT — MEMORY GRID
missions.props: A board, posterboard, or projection showing 12–16 simple icons (guns, cars, dollar signs, masks, badges) in a grid
missions.howItRuns: Show the grid for 10 seconds. Cover it. Pull 3 contestants. Each gets 30 seconds (separately) to recall as many icons as possible. Most correct recalls wins.
missions.handlerVO: Memorize it. You only get one look. Get this wrong and the whole job’s blown.
missions.variation: GROUP RECALL — instead of solo, three contestants take turns naming icons round-robin without repeats. First to repeat or blank is out. Last standing wins.

missions.name: THE CAR JACK — KEYS IN THE BUCKET
missions.props: 1 bucket, ~30 fake car keys (cheap dollar-store sets or printed cutouts), one labeled “GETAWAY KEY” in bold
missions.howItRuns: Pass the bucket of keys into the crowd earlier in the night — each person grabs ONE without looking. At mission time: “We need a wheelman. Whoever’s got the GETAWAY KEY — to the stage.” Whoever finds it wins. If nobody steps up in 60 seconds, you reveal who actually has it.
missions.handlerVO: One of you walked out of here with the keys to the score. Find them. Bring them to me.
missions.variation: MULTIPLE KEYS — mark 3 keys (gold, silver, bronze) with different rewards. Three winners, three tiers of prize.

missions.name: THE TAKEDOWN — TUG OF WAR
missions.gtaRef: Crew vs rival crew turf war
missions.props: One rope (10–15 ft, soft cotton/poly so nobody gets burned), tape line on the floor for the center
missions.howItRuns: Pull two teams of 3 from the crowd. Mark a center line on the floor. Quick 30-second tug of war — first team pulled across loses. Losers do a silly punishment (lead a chant, take a group photo as the “arrested crew”). Winners get drink tickets each.
missions.win: Pull the other team across the center line, OR have more team on your side at the 30-second buzzer.
missions.handlerVO: Two crews. One city. Only one of you walks out tonight — the other one goes down.
missions.variation: BEST OF THREE — instead of one pull, run three quick rounds. Winners switch sides each round. Best record takes it.

missions.name: THE STAKEOUT — CUP STACK SPEED
missions.props: 12 red Solo cups per contestant ($5 on Amazon for plenty), folding table
missions.howItRuns: Pull 3 contestants. Each gets 12 cups in a stack. Race: build a pyramid (6-3-2-1 or 3-2-1 stacked twice = 12 cups), knock it clean, then re-stack into the starting column. First to finish wins. Crowd counts down from 60.
missions.win: First to complete the full sequence (pyramid up, knocked down, re-stacked to single column).
missions.handlerVO: Set the rig. Sixty seconds. We move when you’re ready.
missions.variation: TEAM RELAY — two teams of 3, relay-style. First person stacks the pyramid, second knocks it down, third re-stacks. Faster, louder, team energy.
